title: User Authentication
description: The system shall authenticate users with a unique username and password before granting access.

title: Role-Based Access Control
description: The system shall restrict access to functions based on assigned user roles (Admin / Reviewer / Viewer).

title: Audit Trail Capture
description: The system shall record all data creation modification and deletion events with actor timestamp and change detail.

title: Deviation Record Creation
description: The system shall allow authorized users to create deviation records with title description severity and affected batch.

title: Deviation Status Workflow
description: The system shall support deviation status transitions: Open > Under Investigation > Resolved / Accepted with Risk.

title: Batch Data Import
description: The system shall accept batch deviation data via CSV upload with field validation and duplicate detection.

title: Risk Score Calculation
description: The system shall calculate a risk score for each deviation based on severity recurrence and overdue status.

title: Report Export
description: The system shall allow export of deviation reports in CSV and PDF format.

title: System Availability
description: The system shall maintain 99.5% uptime during business hours (07:00–19:00 local time).

title: Data Backup
description: The system shall perform automated daily backups with a 30-day retention period.

title: Session Timeout
description: The system shall terminate inactive sessions after 15 minutes to prevent unauthorized access.

title: Electronic Signature
description: The system shall require electronic confirmation (actor + reason) for final deviation closure per 21 CFR Part 11.
